title: My Weekend Plan
text:
Hi everyone! This weekend I am going to try a new café near my flat. My friend Anna says the cakes are amazing. I want to take some photos for my blog.

On Sunday, I will visit the park with my dog, Max. We plan to walk for two hours and then have lunch together. I will write a new post about our day on Monday.

questions.text: Where is the writer going this weekend?
options: To a new café near their flat
To a museum in the city centre

questions.text: What does the writer plan to do on Sunday?
options: Visit a park with a dog

questions.text: Why does the writer want to take photos at the café?
options: To share them on the blog
Because the writer does not like cake
Because the writer is leaving the city

questions.text: What kind of blog is this most likely to be?

a meal eaten in the middle of the day

paragraph_translations: Cześć wszystkim! W ten weekend zamierzam wypróbować nową kawiarnię niedaleko mojego mieszkania. Moja przyjaciółka Anna mówi, że ciasta są niesamowite. Chcę zrobić kilka zdjęć na mojego bloga.
W niedzielę pójdę do parku z moim psem Maxem. Planujemy spacerować przez dwie godziny, a potem razem zjeść obiad. W poniedziałek napiszę nowy post o naszym dniu.
